title: Multi-Object Tracking & Video Memory

objectives: Distinguish tracking-by-detection from query-based tracking and name the algorithm families (SORT, DeepSORT, ByteTrack, BoT-SORT, SAM 2 memory tracker, SAM 3.1 Object Multiplex)
